coded: 2026-11-21, from the remark text alone, before any audio was measured
rule: Tier A = the recordist's own words describe a change in how the crows are calling at a stated time. Tier B = an event at a stated time whose effect on calling the recordist does not describe. Only tier A is tested.

tier_a.words: Close to the 2:20 time mark, the Owl hopped to a new branch, causing some ruckus amongst the Crows.
Crowd really gets going at about 1:02.
You can hear the hawk's call at about 1:18 as it flies about 30m to a different tree. The crows become somewhat quieter.
the thick trees muffed the battle, about 35 sec. is when they were getting closer and around 1:00 they were battling.
At about :44 that individual flies off and calls continuously while flying.

tier_b_not_tested.why: a crow lands near an owl; the recordist describes no change in calling
calling 'intensifies' at an unstated time before the hawk calls again at 2:28
the flock takes off after the hawk; no change in calling described
the loudest crow flies off; direction is my guess, not the recordist's
a fledgling is fed; no change in calling described
an adult arrives at begging young; no change described
a juvenile is fed, then adults object to the recordist; two events in one
begging starts; an onset from silence would pass trivially
most of a roost leaves; no change in calling described
